long_biography.plain_text:
Finding value in surplus aircraft inventory became John Dziuba's defining business idea. He founded DASI in 1993 while studying at the University of Florida. He developed the Miami company around acquiring, pricing and redistributing parts that airlines, maintenance organisations and manufacturers no longer needed. Its proprietary systems and online marketplace connected that material with buyers worldwide.

Dziuba steered DASI through successive aviation downturns while directing strategy and e-commerce development. The business grew from a student venture into a global aftermarket platform serving airlines, maintenance providers, manufacturers and distributors. His technical interests extend beyond commerce: he is a private pilot and astrophotographer.
